appropriate interagency m echanism s for the conduct o f multiple agency re­
view s; but, only w here such review s are consistent w ith the statutory obliga­
tions o f the agencies, and only w hen such review s w ill assist in the expedi­
tious processing o f facility permits.
1-107. The D irector o f the O ffice o f M anagem ent and Budget shall assist 
participating Executive agencies w ith the establishm ent o f joint Federal and 
S tate and local agency review s. Such assistan ce shall be lim ited to those 
circum stances w hich are consistent w ith the legal obligations o f the reviewing 
Federal and State and local agencies, and w hich w ill result in the expeditious 
processing of facility perm its.
1-108. The D irector o f the O ffice o f M anagem ent and Budget shall keep the 
President inform ed on agency perform ance in m eeting scheduled decision 
deadlines.
1-109. The Director of the Office of Management and Budget shall, where  
appropriate, coordinate the procedures established herein with those proce­
dures adopted by the Council on Environmental Quality pursuant to Executive  
Order No. 11991 (40 CFR Parts 1500-1508).
1-110. Nothing in this Order is intended to modify in any way (a) the review  
and decision-making responsibilities imposed by Federal or State statutes, or  
(b) the opportunity for timely State and local government and public participa­
tion in agency decision-making.

research_rationale: EO 12129 (signed 1979-04-05, 44 FR 21001-21002), read in full from the held official FR text: enacting words and secs. 1-101 to 1-110 establishing the Critical Energy Facility Program. The OCR text layer of the enacting words and secs. 1-101 to 1-102 is badly garbled (official PDF pages not inspected; original_pages_confirmed false). The dossier's clause inventory omits the enacting words, secs. 1-101, 1-102 and the sec. 1-103 lead-in and merges sec. 1-104(e)-(f) with secs. 1-105 to 1-110(a), so a corrected inventory of nine disjoint spans (enacting words through sec. 1-110, skipping only the page break between secs. 1-104 and 1-105) replaces it. EO 12553 (signed 1986-02-25, effective on signing; the record ACT:EO:12129>EO:12553 is an agent-located Rastell record upheld by an independent AI reviewer with a D6 step; simulated ingestion, not yet in the committed build) revokes it by number. D6 / earlier-end test (did any instrument other than EO 12553, or the order's own dated term, end the order or a clause before 1986-02-25?): The order has no sunset, term, condition or termination clause of its own and no effective-date wording; the deadlines in secs. 1-102, 1-104, 1-105 and 1-108 are permit-decision schedules and reporting, not an end of any clause, and no report deadline is relied on. The by-number scan finds 12129 only in EO 12553 (the EO 12593 hits are FR page-range and CFR parts-affected index entries); 'Critical Energy Facility' appears in no other held order text; the OFR catalog and jobs/status-history record only the EO 12553 revocation; the U.S. Code machine hits are the 42 U.S.C. 2235 editorial note, which says EO 12129 'was revoked by Ex. Ord. No. 12553, Feb. 25, 1986'. No amendment, extension or suspension of EO 12129 is held. No non-express statutory or decontrol lead was identified: the Program is an OMB coordination scheme resting on general Presidential authority, not on a temporary statute. The order is therefore recorded as ending at its first express end, EO 12553, which the President described as eliminating orders 'no longer necessary'; this is not proof of continuous operation to 1986. First end: EO 12553, 1986-02-25. Savings: none_after_bounded_search (see savings_residuals). AI producer hypothesis only; not human certification and not a status.

savings_residuals.reason: Reading record for EO 12553 (held FR text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12553.txt, text_sha256 6361bdc5..., 51 FR 7237, PDF pages 9-15, read for this purpose: heading, the single operative sentence at offsets 691-966 and the signature block): 'to eliminate Executive Orders that are no longer necessary, it is hereby ordered that the following Executive Orders, and any amendments thereto, are revoked:' followed by a two-column 'No. Subject' table; no exception, savings, pending-matter, transfer or 'nothing herein' wording anywhere in the held text (searched saving, nothing in, shall not affect, pending, heretofore, notwithstanding, provided that). Own-residual check, reading EO 12129 in full: it set up an OMB-run coordination program with agency data submissions, deadline schedules and interagency review mechanisms; it created no fund, property or private right, and sec. 1-110 expressly left statutory review duties and State, local and public participation unchanged, so every permit decision rested on the agencies' own statutes. Its schedules and coordination were completed administrative acts. EO 12553 has no savings clause. Nothing of the order outlives its revocation. Bounded search: the order and EO 12553 read in full in the held official FR texts; a by-number scan of all 6,652 held FR order texts (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts; every hit read in context); a subject-word scan of the same texts; the OFR catalog edges for the order (jobs/later-events EDGES.csv); the three machine searches (OFR catalog, U.S. Code, eCFR) read with their scope notes.
